title: Relax at The Retreat At Barrett Place | Rosemary Beach Condo Rental | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: An elegant Rosemary Beach condo rental with luxury amenities is here to enhance your next vacation! Enjoy the stunning views and easy access to sandy beaches! Reserve now!
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

CONSTRUCTION NOTICE - Active balcony construction on building during January to as late as June 1

The Retreat at Barrett Place is an elegant condominium with underground parking garage, restricted elevator access to the residential floors and geothermal heating & cooling. The living room's plush seating ensures maximum comfort while encouraging guests to lounge on natural shade cushions reminiscent of the sandy beaches just a short walk away.

The galley kitchen provides an exotic beat in rich orange and dark green surrounding stainless steel Viking appliances. Well-placed woven accents keep the mood casual and the focus on coastal comfort. The Master retreat features king bed, large oversized shower and spacious walk-in closet. Each of The Retreat at Barrett Place three bedrooms offer linen stone-washed bedding.

Continuing outdoors, the balcony furniture creates two seating areas for dining or leisurely conversation. Cafe lights strung across the balcony ceiling provide the perfect ambiance for a night spent outdoors people watching or listening the waves.

Features of this unit include: Two balconies overlooking N. Barrett Square, Sub Zero Appliances, Impeccable Furnishings, Secured Elevator or Stair Access to Property, Bose Surround Sound and Google Chrome, Dedicated Private Garage Parking under the building, high speed internet access, two complimentary adult bikes.

DURING SPRING BREAK AND SUMMER THIS PROPERTY RENTS 7 NIGHTS FROM SATURDAY-SATURDAY

TempurPedic mattresses installed April 2022

Disclaimer: Active balcony construction on building during January to as late as June 1
